# Ezekiel 34 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 34:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | The LORD gave me this message: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 34:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-fat you-eat and-the-wool you-clothe-yourselves-[with]; the-fattened-ones you-slaughter — the-flock you-do-not-feed. |
| LOGOS | You eat the fat, you clothe yourselves with the wool, you slaughter the fat ones, but you do not feed the flock. |
| PNEUMA | You drink the milk, wear the wool, and butcher the best animals, but you don't feed the sheep. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 34:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-weak you-have-not-strengthened, and-the-sick you-have-not-healed, and-the-broken you-have-not-bound-up, and-the-driven-away you-have-not-brought-back, and-the-lost you-have-not-sought; and-with-force you-have-ruled-them and-with-harshness. |
| LOGOS | The weak you have not strengthened, the sick you have not healed, the injured you have not bound up, the strayed you have not brought back, the lost you have not sought, and with force and harshness you have ruled them. |
| PNEUMA | You have not taken care of the weak. You have not tended the sick or bound up the injured. You have not gone looking for those who wandered away or were lost. Instead, you have ruled them with harshness and cruelty. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 34:15 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | I-Myself will-feed My-flock and-I-Myself will-cause-them-to-lie-down," declares the-Lord YHWH. |
| LOGOS | I Myself will be the shepherd of My sheep, and I Myself will make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD. |
| PNEUMA | I myself will tend my sheep and give them a place to lie down in peace, says the Sovereign LORD. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 34:16 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "The-lost I-will-seek and-the-driven-away I-will-bring-back and-the-broken I-will-bind-up and-the-sick I-will-strengthen; but-the-fat and-the-strong I-will-destroy — I-will-feed-them with-justice." |
| LOGOS | I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak, and the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will feed them in justice. |
| PNEUMA | I will search for my lost ones who strayed away, and I will bring them safely home again. I will bandage the injured and strengthen the weak. But I will destroy those who are fat and powerful. I will feed them — yes — with justice! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 34:19 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-My-flock — the-trampling-of your-feet they-graze, and-the-fouling-of your-feet they-drink." |
| LOGOS | And must My sheep eat what you have trodden with your feet, and drink what you have muddied with your feet? |
| PNEUMA | Why should my flock have to eat what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---
